outcomeNote: a ruling reconciling the halakha with the priests' custom

segments.he: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן, אָמַר לִי הוּנָא: בָּא לִימָּלֵךְ – מוֹרִים לוֹ כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן יַעֲקֹב, נָשָׂא – אֵין מוֹצִיאִים אוֹתָהּ מִמֶּנּוּ, כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי.
segments.en: «Rav Naḥman says:» Rav «Huna said to me:» If a priest «comes to consult» with us as to whether or not he should marry the daughter of two converts, «we instruct him» not to, «in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya’akov.» But if «he married» her, «we do not remove her from him, in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yosei,» as the halakha follows his opinion, as stated above.

moves.cueHe: אמר רב נחמן, אמר לי הונא
moves.summary: Rav Huna's two-tier ruling transmitted by Rav Naḥman
moves.about: the ruling ab initio like R' Eliezer ben Ya'akov, after the fact like R' Yosei

edges.cueHe: מורים לו כרבי אליעזר בן יעקב
edges.about: a priest who consults is instructed not to marry the daughter of two converts

edges.cueHe: אין מוציאים אותה ממנו, כרבי יוסי
edges.about: if he already married her she is not removed from him

positions.claim: instruct a consulting priest like R' Eliezer ben Ya'akov; if he married, do not remove her, like R' Yosei
